description: Certificate of lawfulness for the proposed installation of replacement cladding
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 15 May 2026, the proposal as shown on the drawing(s) submitted on 15/05/2026 and numbered Site Location Plan, 1122-Rgn-Ba-Zz-Dr-W-E2001_Block A Existing North Elevation, 1122-Rgn-Ba-Zz-Dr-W-E2002_Block A Existing East Elevation, 1122-Rgn-Ba-Zz-Dr-W-E2003_Block A Existing South Elevation, 1122-Rgn-Ba-Zz-Dr-W-E2004_Block A Existing West Elevation, 1122-Rgn-Bb-Zz-Dr-W-E2005_Block B Existing North Elevation, 1122-Rgn-Bb-Zz-Dr-W-E2006_Block B Existing East Elevation, 1122-Rgn-Bb-Zz-Dr-W-E2007_Block B Existing South Elevation, 1122-Rgn-Bb-Zz-Dr-W-E2008_Block B Existing West Elevation, 1122-RGN-BA-ZZ-DR-W-P2001-Rev01, Block A Proposed North Elevation, 1122-RGN-BA-ZZ-DR-W-P2002-Rev01, Block A Proposed East Elevation, 1122-RGN-BA-ZZ-DR-W-P2003-Rev01, Block A Proposed South Elevation, 1122-RGN-BA-ZZ-DR-W-P2004-Rev01, Block A Proposed West Elevation, 1122-RGN-BB-ZZ-DR-W-P2005-Rev01, Block B Proposed North Elevation, 1122-RGN-BB-ZZ-DR-W-P2006-Rev01, Block B Proposed East Elevation, 1122-RGN-BB-ZZ-DR-W-P2007-Rev01, Block B Proposed South Elevation and 1122-RGN-BB-ZZ-DR-W-P2008-Rev01, Block B Proposed West Elevation, was lawful within the meanings of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 because:

The proposed works described in the application would not constitute "development" for the purposes of Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended), as they would not involve a material change in the use of land and/or operational development. As such, the proposal would be considered lawful under section 191 or 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act (as amended).
